name: 🔄 BP AI — Deal Lifecycle Orchestrator
description: Every 10 min: converts BP_AI_Deals stage into one idempotent task for Sales→Legal→Finance→Operations; human blockers go only to Baher.

parameters.jsCode: const rows=$input.all().map(i=>i.json); const out=[]; const routes={new:['badr_sales','Qualify lead and establish a commercial next action'],lead:['badr_sales','Qualify lead and establish a commercial next action'],new_lead:['badr_sales','Qualify lead and establish a commercial next action'],qualified:['badr_sales','Advance qualified opportunity toward a quote'],discovery:['badr_sales','Complete discovery and prepare commercial scope'],quote_drafting:['badr_sales','Finish and issue the commercial quotation'],quote_ready:['badr_sales','Issue the quotation and set follow-up'],quote_sent:['badr_sales','Follow up and close the commercial decision'],quote_accepted:['abdulaziz_legal','Prepare/advance the contract for the accepted commercial scope'],contract_required:['abdulaziz_legal','Prepare the client contract'],contract_drafting:['abdulaziz_legal','Complete contract drafting and send for signature'],contract_sent:['abdulaziz_legal','Follow up contract signature and resolve legal comments'],contract_signed:['abdulrahman_finance','Issue invoice and start collection immediately'],invoice_required:['abdulrahman_finance','Prepare and issue invoice'],invoice_drafting:['abdulrahman_finance','Complete and issue invoice'],invoice_issued:['abdulrahman_finance','Confirm invoice delivery and collect payment'],payment_pending:['abdulrahman_finance','Collect outstanding payment and reconcile receipt'],paid:['mazen_ops','Start paid-client execution immediately'],payment_received:['mazen_ops','Start paid-client execution immediately'],execution_ready:['mazen_ops','Start service delivery and assign operational tasks'],execution_in_progress:['mazen_ops','Drive execution to completion and remove blockers'],delivered:['badr_sales','Run post-delivery upsell, renewal and referral follow-up']}; for(const d of rows){const stage=String(d.stage||'').trim().toLowerCase(); let agent,objective; if(d.human_action_required===true||stage==='blocked_human'){agent='baher_owner'; objective=d.next_action||'Complete the required human action blocking this deal';} else {const r=routes[stage]; if(!r) continue; [agent,objective]=r;} const priority=(Number(d.paid_amount||0)>0&&stage!=='delivered')?'P0':(['quote_accepted','contract_signed','invoice_issued','payment_pending','paid','payment_received'].includes(stage)?'P1':(d.priority||'P2')); out.push({json:{task_id:`DEAL-${d.deal_id}-${stage}`,parent_task_id:'',source:'deal_lifecycle',company_id:'business-partner',client_id:d.deal_id||'',client_name:d.client_name||'',channel:'internal',objective,context:`Deal ${d.deal_id}; service=${d.service||''}; stage=${stage}; value=${d.deal_value||0}; quoted=${d.quoted_amount||0}; invoiced=${d.invoiced_amount||0}; paid=${d.paid_amount||0}; quote=${d.quote_status||''}; contract=${d.contract_status||''}; invoice=${d.invoice_status||''}; payment=${d.payment_status||''}; execution=${d.execution_status||''}; next=${d.next_action||''}; blocked_by=${d.blocked_by||''}. IMPORTANT: own this milestone, perform the work with your team, and use your Deal State tool to update BP_AI_Deals when the milestone changes.`,created_by_agent:'deal_lifecycle_orchestrator',assigned_to_agent:agent,priority,status:'queued',approval_required:false,approval_status:'not_required',result:'',next_action:d.next_action||objective,human_action_required:agent==='baher_owner',blocked_by:d.blocked_by||'',cash_stage:stage,revenue_value:Number(d.deal_value||d.quoted_amount||d.invoiced_amount||0),created_at:new Date().toISOString(),updated_at:new Date().toISOString()}});} return out;
